'''Scyks''' were vicious predatory reptiles that were native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They were known for their bloodthirsty temperament.

==Biology and appearance==
The scyk was a species of [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]]<ref name="LoNH" /> that inhabited remote regions of the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Scyks would attack creatures or people on sight and brutally tear through their prey. Thankfully, they usually lived far from most settled areas.<ref name="TOR-Codex" />

==History==
Scyk fangs were prized trophy among [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]].<ref name="TOR-Codex" />

By the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Beastmaster/Legends|beastmaster]] [[Adrazar]] tried to domesticate scyks to serve him as deadly war beasts. However, despite his attempts to [[Animal bond|manipulate]] them through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Sith was unable to force them to cooperate in packs for more than a few days. The only [[Unidentified scyk|one scyk]] that survived was then used by Adrazar to guard his [[Adrazar's domicile|domicile]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="TOR-Codex" />

A number of scyks lived on the swamp planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and were known as '''tremor maws''' by settlers.<ref name="TOR-Taris">{{TORcite|Taris}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the starship manufacturing company [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] named their [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A ''Scyk''-class starfighter]] after this creature.<ref name="LoNH" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a population of scyks populated the atrium of [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]].<ref name="SWG:TA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Atrium|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Scyks first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, the scyks had the same appearance than the [[Dune lizard/Legends|dune lizards]], the [[Rill (species)|rills]] and the [[dragonet]]s.<ref name="SWG" />
